messages:
maya: Quick idea  make gateway retries telemetry-aware so we avoid duplicate attempts and get correct billing/latency attribution.

sam: What problem specifically?

maya: Gateway and upstream both retry; gateway may retry when upstream actually completed but ack was delayed. Results: doubled attempt counts, confusing traces, wrong cost signals. Streaming duplicates tokens.

liam: Proposal sketch: gateway generates opaque attempt id and strips any inbound attempt headers. Upstream returns a short verdict header so gateway can reconcile.

maya: Header sketch:
# gw->up
x-rw-attempt-id: <uuid>
x-rw-parent: <uuid?>
x-rw-idempotency-key: <opt>
# up->gw
x-rw-verdict: retryable|terminal|served
x-rw-reason: timeout|oom|partial
x-rw-chargeable: true|false

rachel: Streaming midflight is tricky. Short-term: conservative rule  do not retry mid-stream; long-term: support resumable fragments via offsets and resume tokens.

ops-bot: [metric] gateway.retry_attempts spike correlated with 95p latency increase.

sam: Observability changes: emit metrics and traces annotated with attempt_id, keep single trace id but add attempt spans. Billing reconciler uses x-rw-chargeable to avoid double charging.

liam: Security: HMAC or gateway-signed attempt id to prevent spoofing. Clients should be able to pass idempotency-key; gateway dedupes within short window.

devx-bot: SDKs: expose idempotency helper and document window semantics.

maya: Migration: per-route opt-in, canary 1% -> 10% -> 100%. I'll write RFC with diagram and table mapping upstream reasons to verdicts.

sam: +1

liam: +1

rachel: +1. Alert rule: if partial reasons >0.5% traffic, escalate.

maya: Thanks  posting RFC link soon.
